# VivuPlan Copilot Instructions

Use the repository instructions as the source of truth:

- Start with `AGENTS.md`.
- For backend work, also read `vivuplan-be/AGENTS.md`.
- For frontend work, also read `vivuplan-fe/AGENTS.md`.
- For architecture, API, AI planning, and setup details, read the relevant files
  under `docs/`.

Do not invent behavior, do not bypass security or credit checks, and keep
Vietnamese user-facing copy encoded as UTF-8.
